**Test scope for ST-101** — coverage estimate: **0.88**; estimated effort: **13.23 hours**; all listed tests are **P1**.

**Unit/API tests (catalog, automation candidates)**
- TC-012 (api, account-service): limits endpoint rejects unauthorized limit overrides
- TC-014 (api, payment-service): repeated idempotency key returns the same instruction
- TC-018 (api, card-service): card status update rejects expired step-up proof
- TC-022 (api, authentication-service): token introspection rejects expired/revoked sessions
- TC-026 (api, api-gateway): card status route enforces required authorization scope
- TC-030 (api, customer-db): customer store adapter rejects stale profile versions
- TC-032 (api, transaction-db): ledger adapter rejects unbalanced debit/credit totals
- TC-038 (api, fraud-engine): fraud screening returns rule version and decision trace

**Functional tests (catalog, automation candidates)**
- TC-011 (account-service): daily limits distinguish premium vs standard eligibility
- TC-013 (payment-service): payments reject amounts exceeding remaining daily limit
- TC-017 (card-service): freeze/unfreeze preserves cardholder linkage
- TC-021 (authentication-service): biometric login verifies device-bound challenge
- TC-025 (api-gateway): payment requests routed with original correlation ID
- TC-029 (customer-db): profile persistence preserves optional preferred name fields
- TC-031 (transaction-db): duplicate posting preserves balanced entries and daily totals

**Integration tests (generated, not automation candidates)**
- GEN-1 (account-service, audit-db, payment-service, transaction-db): audit events capture effective limit + premium eligibility
- GEN-2 (account-service, api-gateway, fraud-engine, payment-service, transaction-db): flag rollback reverts limit to 25,000 AED within one minute
- GEN-3 (audit-db, reporting-db, transaction-db): reporting projections aggregate premium payments correctly
- GEN-4 (api-gateway, mobile-banking, payment-service, transaction-db, web-banking): channels handle limit increase without latency degradation
- GEN-5 (account-service, fraud-engine, payment-service, risk-engine): fraud/risk alignment with new thresholds
- GEN-6 (account-service, mobile-banking, notification-service, web-banking): limit-change notifications delivered reliably

**Security test**
- GEN-7 (account-service, api-gateway, audit-db, authentication-service): unauthorized premium-limit override blocked (403) and audited

**Regression test (automation candidate)**
- GEN-8 (account-service, card-service, loan-service, transaction-db): loan disbursement and card replacement unaffected

**Release gating**: the GO_WITH_CONDITIONS decision requires the above P1 api, functional, integration, security and regression tests to be run before release, including sequencing with ST-107 (transaction-db) and ST-110 (payment-service) collisions on those components.
